description:
Connect your Snapchat Ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track spend, measure performance, and see which creatives are actually working.

Compare impressions, swipe ups, swipe up rate, video views, cost per result, conversions, and return on ad spend across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, ad squad, or ad. Turn your Snapchat advertising data into clear reports and spot where budget is working.

defaultPrompt: How much did I spend on Snapchat Ads last week?
Generate a monthly Snapchat Ads performance report covering the last 30 days
Show me my top performing Snapchat ad creatives for the last 14 days

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Adzviser Snapchat Ads for ChatGPT. Track ad spend, impressions, and swipes, compare performance over time, and explore your campaigns and ads with interactive reports.

positive.description: Monthly performance with calculated efficiency metrics. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this Snapchat Ads plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access the CCAD workspace. These fixed historical dates returned advertising activity during preparation. If CCAD is unavailable, report the access problem instead of choosing another workspace.
positive.prompt: Summarize Snapchat Ads performance in my CCAD workspace for June 2025: spend, impressions, and swipes. Also calculate CPM, swipe-up rate, and cost per swipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name CCAD and date_ranges [["2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"]]. Discover field names, then call retrieve_reporting_data with assorted_requests.snapchat_ads_request metrics Cost, Impressions, Swipes and breakdowns Ad account name, Ad account currency. Leave time_granularity unset. Present the returned counts, currency, and spend; Cost is already in account currency units, so do not divide it by a million again. Clearly label calculated CPM = 1000 * Cost / Impressions, swipe-up rate (%) = 100 * Swipes / Impressions, and cost per swipe = Cost / Swipes. Use totals from the same account and currency, guard zero or missing denominators, and show reasonable rounding. Do not infer missing currency or treat an empty dataset as zero activity. State the inclusive dates and any note_of_assumption. Do not open Preview UI.

positive.description: Compare two complete months in one request. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this Snapchat Ads plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access the CCAD workspace. These fixed historical dates returned advertising activity during preparation. If CCAD is unavailable, report the access problem instead of choosing another workspace.
positive.prompt: In my CCAD workspace, compare Snapchat Ads spend, impressions, and swipes for June 2025 against May 2025. Show absolute and percentage changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name CCAD and one retrieve_reporting_data call with date_ranges [["2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"], ["2025-05-01", "2025-05-31"]]. Request Cost, Impressions, Swipes with breakdowns Ad account name, Ad account currency under snapchat_ads_request, without time_granularity. Identify each period from its returned date range. For each metric calculate June minus May and 100 * (June - May) / May when the baseline is nonzero. Report a zero or missing baseline instead of dividing by zero. Keep currencies separate and disclose any assumptions. Do not open Preview UI or invent missing period values.

positive.description: Rank individual ads while distinguishing duplicate ad names. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this Snapchat Ads plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access the CCAD workspace. These fixed historical dates returned advertising activity during preparation. If CCAD is unavailable, report the access problem instead of choosing another workspace.
positive.prompt: Which five Snapchat ads generated the most swipes in my CCAD workspace during June 2025? Show each ad ID and name, ad squad, campaign, spend, impressions, swipes, and calculated cost per swipe.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name CCAD, date_ranges [["2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"]], and snapchat_ads_request metrics Cost, Impressions, Swipes with breakdowns Ad ID, Ad name, Ad squad name, Campaign name, Ad account currency. Call retrieve_reporting_data without time_granularity. Rank the returned ad rows by Swipes descending and show up to five. Keep distinct Ad IDs separate even when names match. Calculate each cost per swipe from that row's Cost / Swipes, guard zero denominators, and preserve the returned currency. Do not invent server-side sorting, limit, or filter arguments, or claim that a high swipe count proves profitable conversions. Disclose any returned-data limitations; no budget or campaign changes are performed.

positive.description: Daily trend and highest-spend dates. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this Snapchat Ads plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access the CCAD workspace. These fixed historical dates returned advertising activity during preparation. If CCAD is unavailable, report the access problem instead of choosing another workspace.
positive.prompt: Show daily Snapchat Ads spend, impressions, and swipes for my CCAD workspace during June 2025. Which dates had the highest spend?
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name CCAD, date_ranges [["2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"]], time_granularity Date, and snapchat_ads_request metrics Cost, Impressions, Swipes with breakdowns Ad account name, Ad account currency. Call retrieve_reporting_data. Do not put Date in breakdowns. Present returned dates chronologically and identify all dates tied for the maximum returned Cost. Preserve the returned amounts and currency. Do not fabricate missing dates or values. If totals are compared with another report, disclose rounding differences or other assumptions rather than forcing agreement. Do not open Preview UI.

positive.description: Campaign-level reporting including zero-activity campaigns. Run in a fresh ChatGPT conversation with this Snapchat Ads plugin enabled and an authorized account that can access the CCAD workspace. These fixed historical dates returned advertising activity during preparation. If CCAD is unavailable, report the access problem instead of choosing another workspace.
positive.prompt: Show Snapchat Ads spend, impressions, and swipes by campaign in my CCAD workspace for June 2025. Include campaign IDs, keep campaigns with zero activity, and calculate cost per swipe where possible.
positive.expected_behavior: Use workspace_name CCAD and date_ranges [["2025-06-01", "2025-06-30"]]. Call retrieve_reporting_data with assorted_requests.snapchat_ads_request metrics Cost, Impressions, Swipes and breakdowns Campaign ID, Campaign name, Ad account currency, without time_granularity. Present the returned campaign rows in a text table, preserving each ID, name, currency, and numeric value. Include explicit zero-activity rows returned by the service; do not fabricate campaigns absent from the response. Calculate cost per swipe as Cost / Swipes only when Swipes is nonzero. For a zero-swipe campaign, report cost per swipe as undefined or N/A rather than zero or infinity. Surface any note_of_assumption and report an empty result honestly. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data, open a widget, or ask the reviewer to select Run.

negative.description: Unsupported campaign budget update. Explain that this Snapchat Ads connector retrieves reports and cannot change budgets or campaign settings. Do not invoke this plugin's reporting, preview, or discovery tools as a substitute, and do not claim a budget change occurred.
negative.prompt: Increase the daily budget of every Snapchat campaign in my CCAD workspace by 20% right now.

negative.description: Unsupported organic Snapchat publishing. Explain that this connector reports advertising data and cannot post organic content or send Snapchat messages. Do not invoke this plugin's tools or claim that content was posted.
negative.prompt: Post a Snapchat Story to my account saying Our summer sale starts today.

negative.description: Unsupported Meta Ads source. Explain that this plugin only supports Snapchat Ads and that Meta Ads reporting requires a separate connector. Do not invoke this plugin's tools, send fb_ads_request, or substitute Snapchat figures for Facebook or Instagram data.
negative.prompt: Use this Snapchat Ads plugin to retrieve my Facebook and Instagram ad spend for June 2025.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website (https://adzviser.com). This plugin analyzes existing Snapchat Ads data and does not offer in-plugin purchases, checkout, payment processing, ad buying, or advertising budget changes.
